independent_review.review: independent read-only v2 native reference rebuild review

postmap_timing.markers: Original NbMapsComplete through original NbVisible callbacks, rederived directly from raw native logs.

reference_rebuild_native_traces.each_transaction_checks: All 768 input reference words, all 1,024 pending-map words, the complete clear-then-increment output table, all ordered low/high byte write events, entry/exit registers and flags, stack/DP/DBR/counter context, elapsed clocks, and placement inside the original post-map markers.

scope_limitations: No emulator, collector, reseal operation, or source/capture mutation was performed during this review.
Runtime binary and SRAM preservation checks were assigned to the parent review and were not repeated here.
The retained v1 candidate below the 20 percent gate remains rejected; this review concerns the v2 ROM identity above.
